report_name: Identity Attacks Fuel 85% of Ransomware in Education, Sophos Reports

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Malicious email (phishing) was the single most common entry point for ransomware attacks in the education sector, responsible for 31% of attacks in lower education and 29% in higher education, often to steal credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used compromised credentials, often obtained from phishing, to log into systems as legitimate users, bypassing perimeter defenses of educational institutions.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The ultimate goal of the ransomware attacks was to encrypt data to extort a ransom payment. This occurred in 61% of attacks in lower education and 58% across the entire sector.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware actors were observed using vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a technique to prevent system recovery from backups.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: The command-line tool vssadmin.exe was noted as being used by attackers to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

identities.name: Education Sector
identities.description: Educational institutions, including K-12 and higher education, were the subject of a Sophos report on ransomware trends. 85% of ransomware attacks against this sector began with identity compromise.

identities.name: Sophos
identities.description: Cybersecurity firm that authored and published the "State of Ransomware in Education 2026" report.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Delete Shadow Copies
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Delete Shadow Copies
id: 2b8a1b9c-7b1e-4f3a-9c8d-6e5a2b1c9d8e
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.sophos.com/en-us/press/press-releases/2026/08/identity-based-attacks-are-responsible-for-85-of-ransomware-in-education
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-28
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity, although rare.
level: high
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware technique to inhibit system recovery, as mentioned in the report's cyber observables section.
